blurb: Guests enjoy over 60 attractions including a corn maze, farmyard, sunflower maze, jumping pillows, mini golf, hill slides, gemstone mining, animals, games, photo spots, and seasonal events like Sunflower Days and Pumpkin Days. Admission includes access to a 10-acre corn maze, jumping pillows, mini golf, and the farmyard. Some activities require additional purchase via Punch Pass or individual fees.
extraNote: Tickets are non-refundable · Prices increase at the gate · $0.95 processing fee online for day tickets, $0.75 for Season Passes · Tents must be canceled no less than 12 hours prior, $25 non-refundable deposit if less than 12 hours · Season runs July 16 - October 17, 2026
